records.normalizedEnglish: Quiet place; lie or sit comfortably, relax muscles and settle distracting thoughts. Think intently yet calmly about the intended person without frowning or clenched fists. Eye closing may help; if never seen, imagine vague outlines. Vividness is interpreted by the author as rapport, not established external evidence.
Imagine suggesting wishes to the person and that person carrying them out. This coercive historical framing differs from modern consent-based kind-conversation imagery.

Imagine a long tube roughly one foot in diameter, with yourself and the intended person at opposite ends. A faint shadowy ring becomes clearer, an open tube end forms and extends; eventually imagine looking through the length. Some practice or several exercises is qualitative, not a numeric count or timer. The tube is explicitly optional; imagery is described as difficult.
records.originalRussian: Вы можете имѣть хорошіе результаты и безъ примѣненія трубы, однако лучшіе результаты получатъ тѣ, кто окажется способнымъ воспользоваться ею.

records.normalizedEnglish: Author treats tube imagery as a sure sign of full rapport, claims another person’s passivity helps and positive mental state resists. These are historical claims, not actual detection of a receiver or an app matching algorithm.

Author recommends a positive mental state and mentally saying I am when one feels outside influence, claiming protection from thought vibrations. The discussion continues82. This is historical belief, not proof that an outside influence exists or a modern protective treatment.
